description: ReactDOM.render() is deprecated in React 18 (the app keeps running in legacy React 17 mode) — replace with createRoot().render()
ReactDOM.hydrate() is deprecated in React 18 (legacy mode) — replace with hydrateRoot()
act() from react-dom/test-utils is deprecated — import act from 'react' (available from React 18.3)
manualAction: Change `import { act } from 'react-dom/test-utils'` to `import { act } from 'react'`. This requires react ≥ 18.3.0 to be installed.

description: Automatic batching: setState calls in timeouts/promises/native handlers are now batched — may affect code or tests relying on intermediate renders
manualAction: Review any tests that assert on intermediate render states inside setTimeout, Promise.then, or native event handlers. Wrap those assertions in `act()` or use `flushSync` from 'react-dom' to opt out of automatic batching where needed.

description: The ReactDOM.render() callback (third argument) has no createRoot equivalent — move the logic into an effect
manualAction: Search for ReactDOM.render calls with a third callback argument. Move the callback logic into the rendered component (e.g. a useEffect or ref callback), then migrate the call to createRoot().

description: Strict Mode now double-invokes effects (mount → unmount → mount) in development to surface side effects
manualAction: Audit useEffect, useLayoutEffect, and class lifecycle methods for non-idempotent side effects (network requests, analytics calls, subscriptions). Ensure cleanup functions are implemented so double-invocation does not cause observable problems in development.

description: ReactDOM.unstable_batchedUpdates is redundant under React 18 automatic batching
manualAction: With React 18's automatic batching, explicit calls to unstable_batchedUpdates are no longer needed in most cases. Remove them and verify behaviour. If you need to force synchronous rendering, use flushSync from 'react-dom' instead.

description: ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode() is deprecated in React 18 — call root.unmount() on the root returned by createRoot()
manualAction: Keep the root returned by createRoot(container) and call root.unmount() instead of unmountComponentAtNode(container). In tests, unmount the root the test created (React Testing Library unmounts automatically).

description: ReactDOM.unstable_renderSubtreeIntoContainer() is deprecated in React 18 — render into a portal instead
manualAction: Replace unstable_renderSubtreeIntoContainer with ReactDOM.createPortal(children, container) rendered from the parent component, which keeps context working without a second root.

description: ReactDOMServer.renderToNodeStream() is deprecated in React 18 — use renderToPipeableStream() for streaming SSR
manualAction: Switch Node streaming SSR to renderToPipeableStream(element, { onShellReady() { stream.pipe(res) } }) and pair it with hydrateRoot on the client. renderToString keeps working (with limited Suspense support).

description: @types/react 18: the children prop is no longer implicit on React.FC / FunctionComponent — list it explicitly in props
manualAction: Add `children?: React.ReactNode` to the props of every FC that renders children (type-check with tsc to find them). `npx types-react-codemod preset-18 ./src` automates most of this.

description: Tests that render with react-dom directly need globalThis.IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = true under React 18
manualAction: In the test setup file (e.g. setupTests.js / jest.setup.js), set `globalThis.IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = true;` so React 18 knows it runs in an act-aware test environment. React Testing Library ≥ 13 sets this automatically for tests that use it.
